---
title: "unique_p_in_c"
output: html_document
---

"This .rmd was made to document the occurrences of pango belonging to multiple clades, this was first noticed in this github post on the variant nowcast hub (scroll down to see screenshots), where very clearly, there are multiple clades assigned to pango lineages"
https://github.com/reichlab/variant-nowcast-hub/discussions/101

#metadata accessed 3/6/2026 (paper metadata)
#from: https://nextstrain.org/ncov/open/global/6m 
```{r}

#load in 3/6/2026 metadata (original)
metadata_3.6.2026 <- read_tsv("~/growthadvantagecompare/sequences_static/metadata.tsv") 


#count pango lineages with more than 1 unique clade 
lotsoclades1 <- metadata_3.6.2026 %>% 
  group_by(pango_lineage) %>% 
summarize(clades = n_distinct(clade_membership)) %>% 
  filter(clades >= 2) #filter  clade_membership greater than 2

unique_metadata_3.6.2026 <- metadata_3.6.2026 %>% 
  filter(pango_lineage %in% lotsoclades1$pango_lineage) %>% #filter metadata for only pango lineages with more than two clades
  group_by(pango_lineage) %>%
  summarise(unique_clades = paste(unique(clade_membership), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") #summarize in separate column


unique_metadata_3.6.2026


####repeat process with Nextclade_pango column (presumably the nextstrain groups in house pango lineage assignment tool)

#count pango lineages with more than 1 unique clade 
lotsoclades1.1 <- metadata_3.6.2026 %>% 
  group_by(Nextclade_pango) %>% 
summarize(clades = n_distinct(clade_membership)) %>% 
  filter(clades >= 2) #filter  clade_membership greater than 2

 unique_metadata_3.6.2026_1.1 <- metadata_3.6.2026 %>% 
  filter(Nextclade_pango %in% lotsoclades1.1$Nextclade_pango) %>% #filter metadata for only pango lineages with more than two clades
  group_by(Nextclade_pango) %>%
  summarise(unique_clades = paste(unique(clade_membership), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") #summarize in separate column

 
 unique_metadata_3.6.2026 #unique clades per pango lineage using pango_lineage column
 unique_metadata_3.6.2026_1.1 #unique clades per pango lineage using Nextclade_pango column

```
